policy.adapter_decision: Keep the maintained-runtime patch set for v0.14.5: two config surfaces enforce explicit operator decisions before Hermes mutates mounted state, and three native capability-check surfaces preserve the distinction between documented fail-closed absence and an internal probe failure. None can be implemented by an external adapter after startup.

dispositions.purpose: Enforce OKF write authorization and reserved/tombstone invariants in native file operations.
dispositions.rationale: Backend-resolved vault write, replacement, move and delete guard; structural and schema enforcement retained.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire only when all Hermes file mutations support an equivalent external policy hook.

dispositions.purpose: Reject doubled wiki path segments caused by confused working directories.
dispositions.rationale: Task-resolved doubled-path refusal retained.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream validates canonicalized write paths equivalently.

dispositions.purpose: Strip mutating tools from failure-report agents.
dispositions.rationale: Failed script receives an empty report-only toolset.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream failure agents are report-only by contract.

dispositions.purpose: Supply corrected DeepSeek v4 peak pricing metadata.
dispositions.rationale: Native DeepSeek rows retained; add direct-provider peak policy and unknown historical bucket.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire after the pinned upstream pricing table contains verified equivalent entries.

dispositions.purpose: Close delegated session rows instead of leaking active state.
dispositions.rationale: Native child close and session-row finalization replace carried cleanup; real-builder normal/deferred test artifact supplies negative-gate evidence, while CI/canary proof remains required.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream always stamps delegated session completion.

dispositions.purpose: Thread a lane-specific Ollama context limit through agent initialization.
dispositions.rationale: Per-job context size threaded through split agent init with early validation.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream exposes an equivalent per-job context configuration contract.

dispositions.purpose: Select the interactive API model independently from gateway defaults.
dispositions.rationale: API-only provider/model runtime tuple resolved independently and fail closed.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream supports independent API-server model routing.

dispositions.purpose: Rotate available web-search backends to distribute rate-limit load.
dispositions.rationale: Search-only rotation ported to split provider registry with extraction capability separation.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if provider rotation becomes an upstream policy extension.

dispositions.purpose: Initialize only MCP servers explicitly enabled for a cron lane.
dispositions.rationale: Native scoped MCP discovery plus explicit required-surface gate.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream makes toolset-scoped MCP initialization mandatory.

dispositions.purpose: Expose file reads without a parallel native write path.
dispositions.rationale: Read-only file subsets closed to hostile plugin and MCP alias resolution.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream ships an equivalent stable read-only toolset.

dispositions.purpose: Apply status-specific retry and fallback behavior for local inference pools.
dispositions.rationale: Per-status total-attempt and fallback contract ported across split retry recovery; output-cap correction respects disabled auto-compaction and classifies repeated request-shape rejection without a false gateway context-reset signal in either mode.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream retry policy supports equivalent per-status configuration.

dispositions.purpose: Clarify MCP resource URI constraints in schemas and errors.
dispositions.rationale: Resource URI guidance distinguishes advertised file URI from host-local file.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream schemas and errors provide equivalent guidance.

dispositions.purpose: Expose actual tool-call counts to completion receipt verification.
dispositions.rationale: Handler-completion count replaces synthetic tool-call rows.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream emits authoritative per-run tool-call evidence.

dispositions.purpose: Expose canonical executed write identities to receipt verification.
dispositions.rationale: Canonical OKEngine write receipts captured at handler dispatch.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream emits canonical write receipts after tool execution.

dispositions.purpose: Cache local server capability detection per normalized endpoint.
dispositions.rationale: Native TTL cache retained; credential-scoped keying replaces unsafe URL-only sharing.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream caches positive and negative capability probes.

dispositions.purpose: Avoid unsupported metadata endpoints based on detected server type.
dispositions.rationale: llama.cpp props route memo learns successful endpoint with bounded expiry.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream probes only server-supported endpoint shapes.

dispositions.purpose: Route Qwen Coder custom providers through the Responses transport.
dispositions.rationale: Preserve the carried model-name Responses force even against explicit Chat api_mode; keep non-Qwen custom routes conservative. Target port retypes legacy role items and scopes the final-wire Relay preflight to forced custom Qwen routes so native Codex string input remains valid. Endpoint/profile migration and Chat wire switch are superseded; observed HTTP wire and negative mutation gates remain before promotion.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream custom-provider routing negotiates Responses semantics equivalently.

dispositions.purpose: Honor a bounded per-job maximum agent iteration count.
dispositions.rationale: Per-job cron iteration cap retained with malformed-value rejection. The same governed artifact prevents upstream config/SOUL migrations from overriding the explicitly selected 50/3 delegation limits, 30/90 curator windows, and existing deployment voice.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream supports and enforces per-job iteration ceilings.

dispositions.purpose: Require explicit terminal receipts for selected-item jobs.
dispositions.rationale: Selected-item terminal receipt prompt fork retained.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if receipt guidance moves into a stable upstream extension hook.

dispositions.purpose: Distinguish runtime evidence text from operator prompt overrides.
dispositions.rationale: Skill evidence provenance split retained without disabling prompt hardening.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream scans prompt directives with equivalent provenance context.

dispositions.purpose: Attach deployment and conversation attribution to Responses traffic.
dispositions.rationale: Responses wire attribution retained at physical request boundary.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream provides configurable equivalent attribution headers.

dispositions.purpose: Fail cron runs whose required MCP surface resolves to zero tools.
dispositions.rationale: Combined with 09: fail closed on absent job-authorized MCP surfaces.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream validates required tool surfaces before agent construction.

dispositions.purpose: Recover MCP tools lost during reconnect publication races and make unrecovered loss fatal to cron integrity.
dispositions.rationale: Registry recovery and structural terminal transport failure telemetry make scheduled fires and audits fail closed without interpreting tool prose.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream atomically preserves or republishes advertised MCP tools across transport reconnects and scheduled runs fail on unrecovered registry loss.

dispositions.purpose: Expose selected cron tools directly to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash while preserving fail-closed bridge semantics for other sessions.
dispositions.rationale: Captured provider-contract output shows DeepSeek Flash combining multiple local invocations into the generic tool_call bridge. A provider- and model-qualified ContextVar keeps local schemas direct for one cron conversation without mutating global configuration or changing other sessions.
dispositions.retirement_criteria: Retire when the supported DeepSeek production endpoint reliably emits one local bridge invocation per tool call or supports validated strict schemas for the bridge.
